select t.* from (select lcrb.batch_id, lcrb.batch_number, lcrb.batch_status, lcrb.repayment_date, lcrb.credit_bp_id, (select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = lcrb.credit_bp_id) as credit_bp_n, (select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = lcrb.credit_bp_id) as credit_bp_name, (SELECT DISTINCT fc.company_full_name FROM fnd_company fc, lon_con_repayment_batch_ln ln, lon_contract lc WHERE ln.batch_id = lcrb.batch_id AND ln.contract_id = lc.contract_id and fc.company_id = lc.lon_company_id) AS lon_company_id_n, (SELECT DISTINCT lc.lon_company_id FROM lon_con_repayment_batch_ln ln, lon_contract lc WHERE ln.batch_id = lcrb.batch_id AND ln.contract_id = lc.contract_id ) lon_company_id, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.code = 'LON.REPAYMENT_BATCH_STATUS' and s.code_value = lcrb.batch_status) as batch_status_n, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id = lcrb.created_by) created_by_n, (select lcbat.out_bank_account_name from lon_con_bank_acc_transfer lcbat where lcbat.batch_id = lcrb.batch_id) with_bank_account_id_n,
(select lcbat.out_bank_account_num from lon_con_bank_acc_transfer lcbat where lcbat.batch_id = lcrb.batch_id) with_bank_account_num, (select to_char(wm_concat(lcw.withdraw_number)) from lon_con_repayment_batch_ln lcn, lon_contract_withdraw lcw where lcn.withdraw_id = lcw.withdraw_id and lcn.batch_id = lcrb.batch_id) as withdraw_number, (select to_char(wm_concat(lc.contract_number)) from lon_con_repayment_batch_ln lcn, lon_contract lc where lcn.contract_id = lc.contract_id and lcn.batch_id = lcrb.batch_id) as contract_number,
lcrb.confirm_seq, lcrb.confirm_status , (case lcrb.confirm_status when 'N' then '未确认' when null then '未确认' when 'Y' then'已确认' else '未确认' end) as confirm_status_n, lcrb.confirm_person, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id = lcrb.confirm_person ) as confirm_person_n, lcrb.confirm_unit, (select fou.unit_name from fnd_org_unit fou where fou.unit_id = lcrb.confirm_unit)as confirm_unit_n, CASE WHEN lcrb.confirm_seq IS NOT NULL AND lcrb.confirm_status = 'Y' THEN lcrb.batch_number || '【' || lcrb.confirm_seq || '】' ELSE lcrb.batch_number END AS batch_number_seq, ( SELECT ROUND( sum( ln.planned_due_amount ), 2 ) FROM lon_con_repayment_batch_ln ln WHERE ln.batch_id = lcrb.batch_id ) AS repayment_amount_total, lcrb.description, lcrb.creation_date
from lon_con_repayment_batch lcrb order by lcrb.creation_date desc) t
and t.batch_number like concat('%',concat(#{batchNumber},'%'))
and t.batch_status like concat('%',concat(#{batchStatus},'%'))
and t.repayment_date = #{plannedDueDate}
and t.credit_bp_name like concat('%',concat(#{creditBpName},'%'))
and t.lon_company_id_n like concat('%',concat(#{lonCompanyIdN},'%'))
and t.credit_bp_name like concat('%',concat(#{bpName},'%'))
and t.repayment_date > #{plannedDueDateFrom}
and t.repayment_date < #{plannedDueDateTo}
and t.withdraw_number like concat('%',concat(#{withdrawNumber},'%'))
and t.contract_number like concat('%',concat(#{contractNumber},'%'))
and t.creation_date >= to_date(#{plannedCalcDateFrom}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
and t.creation_date <= to_date(#{plannedCalcDateTo}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
and created_by_n like #{createdByN}

(select to_char(wm_concat(distinct scvb.meaning)) FROM sys_code_value_b scvb, sys_code_b scb, lon_con_bank_acc_transfer lcbat WHERE scb.code = 'CHS.CURRENCY_TYPE' and scb.code_id = scvb.code_id and scvb.enabled_flag = 'Y' and scvb.value = lcbat.currency and lcbat.batch_id = lcrb.batch_id) as currency_n, (SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = lcrb.credit_bp_id) AS credit_bp_name, 'RONGZI' as fund_document_type, lcrb.creation_date as create_date
from lon_con_repayment_batch lcrb where lcrb.principal_flag = 'Y'

select

(select to_char(wm_concat(ccl.in_payment_id_rc)) from lon_contract_csh_ln ccl where ccl.contract_id = lc.contract_id) in_payment_id_n,
(select to_char(wm_concat(ccl.pay_bank_account_num)) from lon_contract_csh_ln ccl where ccl.contract_id = lc.contract_id) out_bank_account_num,
(select to_char(wm_concat(ccl.rec_bank_account_num)) from lon_contract_csh_ln ccl where ccl.contract_id = lc.contract_id) in_bank_account_num,
(select sum(ccl.csh_payment_amount) from lon_contract_csh_ln ccl where ccl.contract_id = lc.contract_id) as payment_amount,
(select to_char(wm_concat(distinct scvb.meaning)) FROM sys_code_value_b scvb, sys_code_b scb, lon_contract_csh_ln ccl WHERE scb.code = 'CHS.CURRENCY_TYPE' and scb.code_id = scvb.code_id and scvb.enabled_flag = 'Y' and scvb.value = ccl.currency and ccl.contract_id = lc.contract_id) as currency_n,
(select hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = lc.credit_bp_id) as credit_bp_name, 'RONGCHU' as fund_document_type, lc.csh_creation_date as create_date
from lon_contract lc WHERE lc.contract_type_inout = 'OUT' AND lc.contract_status = 'APPROVED' AND lc.data_class = 'NORMAL' and lc.contract_csh_number is not null and lc.principal_flag = 'Y' union
select
cbt.transfer_id as document_id,
cbt.confirm_status, (case when cbt.confirm_status = 'N' then '未确认' when cbt.confirm_status = NULL then '未确认' when cbt.confirm_status = 'Y' then '已确认' else '未确认' end )AS confirm_status_n, cbt.confirm_person, (SELECT su.description FROM sys_user su WHERE su.user_id = cbt.confirm_person) AS confirm_person_n, cbt.confirm_unit, (SELECT fou.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fou WHERE fou.unit_id = cbt.confirm_unit) AS confirm_unit_n, cbt.confirm_date, cbt.confirm_seq, CASE WHEN cbt.confirm_seq IS NOT NULL AND cbt.confirm_status = 'Y' THEN cbt.TRANSFER_NUMBER || '【' || cbt.confirm_seq || '】' ELSE cbt.TRANSFER_NUMBER END AS batch_number_seq,
cbt.PAYMENT_DATE as repayment_date, (select to_char(wm_concat(fc.company_full_name)) from csh_bank_transfer_detail cbtd, fnd_company fc where cbtd.transfer_id = cbt.transfer_id and fc.company_id = cbtd.payment_company_id) out_payment_id_n,
(select to_char(wm_concat(fc.company_full_name)) from csh_bank_transfer_detail cbtd, fnd_company fc where cbtd.transfer_id = cbt.transfer_id and fc.company_id = cbtd.receipt_company_id) in_payment_id_n,
(select to_char(wm_concat(cba.bank_account_num)) from csh_bank_transfer_detail cbtd, csh_bank_account cba where cbtd.transfer_id = cbt.transfer_id and cba.bank_account_id = cbtd.payment_bank_account_id) out_bank_account_num,
(select to_char(wm_concat(cba.bank_account_num)) from csh_bank_transfer_detail cbtd, csh_bank_account cba where cbtd.transfer_id = cbt.transfer_id and cba.bank_account_id = cbtd.receipt_bank_account_id) in_bank_account_num,
(select sum(cbtd.payment_amount) from csh_bank_transfer_detail cbtd where cbtd.transfer_id = cbt.transfer_id) as payment_amount,
(select to_char(wm_concat(distinct scvb.meaning)) FROM sys_code_value_b scvb, sys_code_b scb, csh_bank_transfer_detail cbtd WHERE scb.code = 'CHS.CURRENCY_TYPE' and scb.code_id = scvb.code_id and scvb.enabled_flag = 'Y' and scvb.value = cbtd.currency and cbtd.transfer_id = cbt.transfer_id) as currency_n,
'同户名调拨' as credit_bp_name, 'TONGHUMING' as fund_document_type, cbt.creation_date as create_date
from csh_bank_transfer cbt where cbt.principal_flag = 'Y'
) t
and t.batch_number_seq like concat('%',concat(#{batchNumberSeq},'%'))
and t.credit_bp_name like concat('%',concat(#{creditBpName},'%'))
and t.credit_bp_name like concat('%',concat(#{bpName},'%'))
and t.withdraw_number like concat('%',concat(#{withdrawNumber},'%'))
and t.contract_number like concat('%',concat(#{contractNumber},'%'))
and t.confirm_status = #{confirmStatus}
and t.confirm_status_n = #{confirmStatusN}
and t.payment_amount >= #{paymentAmountFrom}
and t.payment_amount <= #{paymentAmountTo}
and t.currency_n = #{currencyN}

lcrb.confirm_seq, lcrb.confirm_status , (case when lcrb.confirm_status = 'N' then '未确认' when lcrb.confirm_status = NULL then '未确认' when lcrb.confirm_status = 'Y' then '已确认' else '未确认' end ) confirm_status_n, lcrb.confirm_person, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id = lcrb.confirm_person ) as confirm_person_n, lcrb.confirm_unit, (select fou.unit_name from fnd_org_unit fou where fou.unit_id = lcrb.confirm_unit)as confirm_unit_n, lcrb.confirm_date,
(select to_char(wm_concat(distinct lc.document_type)) from lon_con_repayment_batch_ln ln, lon_contract lc where ln.batch_id = lcrb.batch_id and ln.contract_id = lc.contract_id) as document_type,
(select to_char(wm_concat(distinct scv.MEANING)) from sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv, lon_con_repayment_batch_ln ln, lon_contract lc where ln.batch_id = lcrb.batch_id and ln.contract_id = lc.contract_id and sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'FIN.CREDIT_METHOD' and scv.value = lc.document_type) document_type_n, (SELECT to_char(WM_CONCAT(DISTINCT fc.company_full_name)) FROM fnd_company fc, lon_con_repayment_batch_ln ln, lon_contract lc WHERE ln.batch_id = lcrb.batch_id AND ln.contract_id = lc.contract_id and fc.company_id = lc.lon_company_id) AS lon_company_id_n
from lon_con_repayment_batch lcrb where lcrb.confirm_status = 'Y' order by lcrb.batch_id desc) t

and to_char(t.repayment_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') = to_char(to_date(#{plannedDueDate},'yyyy-MM-dd'),'yyyy-MM-dd')
